title: Cuna: Renewable energy vital to sovereignty, national security

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Transitioning to renewable power is essential to protecting the Philippines against international supply shocks and geopolitical instability, Secretary Juan Miguel Cuna told senior decision-makers during New York Climate Week. Cuna made that remark on Sept. 20 as part of his keynote address at a high-level reception hosted by Danish green fund manager Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) in Manhattan. “The world is navigating an era of complex geopolitical change, where the traditional paradigms of national security are rapidly evolving,” Cuna said, as quoted in a statement issued on Tuesday by the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR).
